A1.justification: Both PDFs contain readable, complete versions of the same Cumulative Reasoning paper. Their text, equations, figures, tables and appendices can be matched despite extensive reorganization.

before.justification: v6 reports original logical-inference, Game of 24 and MATH experiments, including reproduced comparisons and FOLIO ablations. The separately attributed third-party appendix results are distinguishable.

after.justification: v7 retains the original benchmark experiments and ablations and adds a repeated Game of 24 diagnostic experiment in Appendix B, Table 17.

M1.justification: Both versions retain the proposer-verifier-reporter loop, accumulation of validated propositions, Game of 24 state search and Python-assisted MATH reasoning. The rewritten descriptions and expanded code prompt do not establish a changed algorithm or model.

E1.justification: The benchmark and task coverage is retained, including the appendix examples and logical-inference benchmarks. Table 17 selects puzzles from the existing Game of 24 test set. Intermediate Algebra loses separate score reporting, without a documented removal from evaluation.

E2.justification: Corresponding benchmark comparisons retain Direct/Standard, CoT, CoT-SC, ToT, Complex CoT with and without PHP, PAL and ToRA. Changed PoT/PAL wording in the abstract does not correspond to adding or removing a separately reported comparator.

E3.justification: v7 adds a two-stage Game of 24 protocol on three test puzzles selected for a unique solution path, comparing direct solving with staged success probabilities. Existing benchmark splits and budgets are retained. The code-MATH difficulty-table caption also drops GPT-4-turbo, without establishing that those experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Appendix B adds a focused experiment investigating whether staged solving and intermediate verification improve success on three Game of 24 puzzles. The original FOLIO verifier/random-choice ablations, worked examples and dataset-error analyses are retained after relocation.

E5.justification: Table 17 newly reports 1,000 repetitions per case for the added diagnostic experiment. No confidence intervals, significance tests or seed information are added, and increased repetitions are not reported for the retained benchmark experiments.

E6.justification: Table 17 adds direct success rates of 3.0/0.0/1.8% and staged probability products of 5.0/5.2/4.4%. v7 omits Intermediate Algebra entries from the MATH tables; retained benchmark scores match. Prose changes the FOLIO margin from 8.42 to 8.62 and AutoTNLI from 9.3 to 12.8. The latter incorrectly names CoT-SC: 72.5 minus 61.7 is 10.8 points.

T1.justification: v6 Appendix C assumes 100% verifier accuracy; v7 Appendix B changes this to near-perfect accuracy. The probability-ordering theorem and proof are otherwise retained, without introducing a verifier-error parameter or corresponding correction.

C1.justification: The central framework contribution and principal superiority claims for logical inference, Game of 24 and MATH remain. The introduction still reports 72.2% code-enabled MATH accuracy despite its omission from the shortened abstract. The added diagnostic supports an existing claim.

C2.justification: v7 newly asserts that Python or Lean can achieve the near-perfect verification assumed in its analysis. It also omits v6's MATH discussion of possible training-data overlap outside the selected 500-example subset. The substantive FOL/HOL limitations remain.

D1.justification: v7 Figure 16 expands the existing code prompt with explicit interpreter-use instructions. Conversely, v7 removes the GPT-4-0314/8k-context specification, the logical-inference no-fine-tuning statement, and explicit single-session/no-additional-verifier information, including Sessions columns. The code-access link is retained.

R1.justification: v7 adds discussion and citations covering multiagent debate, scratchpads, Chain of Code and self-correction. It removes the generic large-model overview and associated references such as PaLM, GLaM and OPT. The central positioning against CoT and ToT remains.

P1.justification: The abstract, background, method and experimental narrative are extensively rewritten and condensed. MATH becomes part of the experiments section, worked examples move into Appendix D, prompts move to Appendix F, and an appendix contents page is added.

P2.justification: Typography, spacing and display placement change throughout. Tables are regrouped under additional captions, MATH columns are removed, result highlighting changes, and worked-example and prompt boxes are redistributed across pages. Table 17 is new; the principal reasoning diagrams are retained and resized.

improvement.justification: Clearer organization and the repeated Game of 24 diagnostic provide benefits, but reporting completeness and precision decline. v7 removes Intermediate Algebra results and reproducibility details, introduces the incorrect AutoTNLI/CoT-SC comparison, and relaxes verifier accuracy without adjusting the proof. These losses outweigh the limited added evidence, while the retained main results keep the overall deterioration modest.
